unwelcome.title: Unwelcome persons list
unwelcome.intro: The list is for serious incidents only: violence or threats, organised or documented repeat theft, or other cases confirmed by approvers; never for ordinary shoplifting. Every entry needs an evidence reference and an expiry date (at most 12 months) and takes effect only after someone with approval permission approves it.
unwelcome.objectStoreMissing: The private photo bucket is not configured, so entries with photos cannot be submitted.
unwelcome.writeBlocked: The feature is not enabled. View only; entries cannot be submitted.

approve.title: Approve this entry?
approve.content: Once approved the entry takes effect and cameras in the stores in scope start matching against it.
approve.contentTwo: This entry needs {{needed}} different approvers and has {{done}} so far. Your approval counts toward that; it takes effect only when complete, except that one administrator's approval takes effect immediately.

withdraw.title: Withdraw entry
withdraw.warning: The entry becomes inactive immediately and its face data at Tencent Cloud and reference photos are deleted. This cannot be undone.

dispute.title: Dispute and correction note
dispute.description: When a person asks about or disputes their record it must be handled within 30 days. Record what was done here, without names or private details.
dispute.label: Note

form.title: Submit list entry
form.scopeNotice: Confirm the incident is serious. An entry stores only the incident category, evidence reference and reference photos; do not enter names or private details in any field. It takes effect only after someone with approval permission approves it; an administrator can approve it alone.
form.otherNeedsApproval: Entries with the Other category need two different approvers before they take effect unless an administrator approves; one administrator's approval is enough.
form.evidenceRefHint: Enter the incident record or police report number. Do not enter names or other private details.
form.storeScopeHint: Default to the store where the incident happened; select at least one ({{count}} selected).
form.expiresHint: Required, at most {{months}} months from today ({{latest}}); the entry is deactivated and deleted when it expires.
form.photosHint: Add 1-5 photos (JPG or PNG, up to 5MB each); used only for side-by-side comparison during review. Do not add photos of people unrelated to the incident.
form.confirmContent: You are submitting an entry for {{stores}} store(s) with {{photos}} reference photo(s), expiring {{expiresOn}}. It takes effect only after someone with approval permission approves it. The photos are uploaded to private storage.
form.submittedMessage: The entry was submitted and will take effect once approved.
form.uncertainNote: Check the list first to see whether the entry was already submitted, to avoid submitting twice.

errors.unsupportedType: Only JPG or PNG photos are supported (HEIC from iOS is converted to JPG automatically). This format is not supported.
errors.sourceTooLarge: This photo file is too large to process. Pick another.
errors.decodeFailed: This photo could not be read. Pick another.
errors.tooLarge: This photo is still over 5MB after compression. Pick another.
errors.tooMany: At most {{max}} photos; extra selections were ignored.
errors.cameraPermission: No camera permission, so a photo cannot be taken.
errors.libraryPermission: No photo library permission, so photos cannot be selected.

leave.discardMessage: Leaving discards what you entered and the photos you picked.
leave.busyMessage: Wait for the submission to finish before leaving.

review.intro: A review task comes from a possible match between a camera capture and the list. One colleague with review permission compares the live capture with the reference photos and decides once: same person confirms the task, not the same person dismisses it. The system never refuses service or notifies police automatically.
review.sensitiveNotice: A suspected match that needs manual confirmation. This is sensitive biometric information: viewing is logged, do not screenshot or share it. Names and incident details are not shown, and images are cleared as soon as you leave this screen or switch to the background.
review.similarity: Similarity {{percent}}% (not the probability of being the same person)
review.notProbability: Similarity only says how alike the two faces look; it does not say how likely they are the same person.

step.pending: Waiting for review: compare the live capture with the reference photos and decide

blocked.imageGone: The capture was deleted under the retention period, so it can no longer be reviewed.
blocked.readOnly: The feature is not enabled. View only; decisions cannot be submitted.
blocked.cannotReview: You cannot submit a decision right now (no review permission for this store, or the task no longer needs your decision).

review.noReference: No reference photos are available (the entry may have been withdrawn or expired).
review.imageGone: The capture was deleted under the retention period, so this task can no longer be reviewed.

confirmMatch.title: Confirm "Same person"?
confirmMatch.content: You are deciding that the live capture and the reference photo show the same person (similarity {{percent}}%, not the probability of being the same person). Once confirmed, the task ends; the system never refuses service or notifies police automatically.

confirmNotMatch.title: Confirm "Not the same person"?
confirmNotMatch.content: Once you decide it is not the same person, the task is dismissed and ends.

review.submittedNotMatch: Recorded: not the same person, task dismissed

settings.title: Face match settings
settings.legalNotice: Important: before Match, customer de-duplication or the Unwelcome Persons List runs on real customers, the legal sign-off, privacy impact assessment and signage records must be in place. Missing records are shown as red warnings and do not block saving or enabling, but they are still legally required before running on real customers. This page does not replace legal judgement.

profile.title: Store profile
profile.loadFailed: Failed to load the store profile
profile.neverSaved: This store has no saved profile yet; the defaults (Off) apply.

mode.offHint: Off: captures from this store's cameras are not processed.
mode.captureHint: Capture: keeps everything and lets you view images in admin; only for integration testing with consenting internal staff. Filling in "Allowed subjects" is recommended.
mode.matchHint: Match: matches captures and keeps no unmatched images. Missing legal sign-off and related records show as red warnings (they do not block enabling) and must be completed before it runs on real customers.

hints.evaluateMatch: Evaluate only, with no effect on the store; requires Capture mode.
hints.staffExclusion: Excludes enrolled staff from traffic counts; needs store members with a valid consent and enrolment.
hints.trafficDedup: De-duplicates customers by face per day. High legal risk. A missing de-duplication legal sign-off or other record shows as a red warning and does not block enabling, but it must be completed before running on real customers.
hints.unwelcomeList: Alerts staff on a list match and creates a review task for manual confirmation. Missing assessment, legal sign-off, signage or training records show as red warnings and do not block enabling, but they must be completed before running on real customers.
hints.unwelcomeAutoConfirmScore: When a task's similarity reaches or exceeds this value, the system automatically marks the task as Confirmed and no manual review is needed (staff still get the alert; the system never refuses service or notifies police automatically). Enter 0 to turn auto-confirm off; the default is 90. Similarity is not the probability of being the same person.
hints.allowedSubjects: Recommended for Capture mode: say who may appear in front of the cameras, all informed and consenting (leaving it empty only shows a hint).
hints.timeZone: Leave on Auto to detect automatically. Effective time zone: {{zone}}; state: {{jurisdiction}}.

profile.complianceWarning: Compliance records incomplete ({{count}} in total): you can save and enable; problems are shown as hints only.
profile.webOnly: Compliance records (PIA, signage, legal sign-off, cross-border review, staff training and so on) are not edited on the phone and are kept exactly as saved; complete them in the web admin under Face Matching > Store profiles.
profile.savedWithWarnings: Store profile saved, but {{count}} compliance record(s) are still incomplete: they must be completed before running on real customers
profile.confirmTitle: Save the face match profile for {{store}}?
profile.confirmMatchWarning: After switching to Match, real captures from this store's cameras start being matched. Make sure the compliance records are complete (see the warnings below).
profile.confirmCaptureWarning: After switching to Capture, every capture from this store's cameras is kept; it may only be used with informed, consenting internal people.
profile.confirmKeep: All other compliance records are kept as they are and will not be changed.

cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.loadFailed: Failed to load the camera list
cameras.pushNotice: Enabling or disabling a camera takes effect in the face ingest service within 30 seconds. An enabled camera that pushed within the last {{minutes}} minutes is "Recently active"; a camera only pushes when it detects a face and sends nothing when nobody passes by. Capture counts cover the last {{hours}} hours.
cameras.empty: No cameras are registered for this store
cameras.emptyHint: Add cameras in the web admin under Face capture cameras.
cameras.summary: {{total}} total · Recently active {{active}} · No recent pushes {{quiet}} · Disabled {{disabled}}
cameras.webOnly: Adding cameras and rotating tokens can only be done in the web admin for security reasons; they are not available on the phone.
cameras.noRecentPushTip: A camera only pushes when it detects a face and sends nothing when nobody passes by, so "No recent pushes" does not mean the camera is powered off or offline.
cameras.confirmDisableContent: The face ingest service will stop accepting pushes from this camera (within 30 seconds). You can enable it again at any time.
